<thought>Based on the ¹H NMR data (two 6 H singlets for N,N‑dimethyl groups, an 8 H aromatic pattern consistent with two para‑substituted phenyl rings, and a 2 H doublet at ~4.5 ppm indicating a benzylic CH₂ attached to an electronegative atom), the most plausible structure is bis(4‑dimethylaminophenyl)methanol. Its SMILES representation is:

CN(C)c1ccc(cc1)C(O)c2ccc(cc2)N(C)C

This matches the observed integrations and the molecular ion m/z ≈ 268 (M + H⁺).
